prompt:
You are an OpenCode-enabled assistant tasked with implementing and validating a multi-language, parity-checked Unix-like multicall suite in the gvibu-ai-lab repository. Your goal is to implement the MVP commands (pwd, echo, true) and a parity-friendly new command (basename) in both Python and Rust, wire up shared specs and machine-readable tests, extend the parity harness, and provide CI coverage. You must produce concrete patch blocks in the repository patch format (the same “*** Begin Patch”/“*** End Patch” envelopes used in this project).
Scope and success criteria
- Implement commands pwd, echo, true (and basename) in both Python and Rust, following a shared spec approach.
- Specs and tests:
  - specs/commands/<cmd>.md: human-readable spec for each command
  - shared-tests/cases/<cmd>.json: machine-readable test cases
  - Python: python-ref/gvibu_ref/commands/<cmd>.py
  - Rust: rust/src/commands/<cmd>.rs
  - Tests: tests/test_<cmd>.py for Python reference (using pytest) and any necessary wiring for Rust parity
- Parity harness:
  - tooling/compare_impls.py updated to include all implemented commands
  - Run parity locally and fix mismatches until parity passes for all commands
- Dispatch wiring:
  - Python dispatcher (python-ref/main.py) updated to expose new command in COMMANDS and to forward arguments properly
  - Rust dispatcher (rust/src/main.rs) updated to include basename and route its command
- Documentation and status:
  - Update docs/command-status.md with new commands and status
  - Update any architecture-related docs if needed to reflect new parity workflow
- Test harness and local tooling:
  - tmux-run-parallel.sh: robust, tmux-aware script to spawn parallel test panes (optional but provided)
  - Ensure parity can be run in CI
- CI:
  - A GitHub Actions workflow parity.yml that builds the Rust parity binary, runs parity checks, and runs Python unit tests for the MVP set plus new commands
- Acceptance: All parity checks pass (Python vs Rust) for all implemented commands; unit tests pass; Rust builds succeed; CI workflow passes
What you should provide (patch plan)
- For each new or updated command (<cmd> in {pwd, echo, true, basename}):
  - Spec patch
    - Add or update specs/commands/<cmd>.md
  - Python implementation patch
    - Add or update python-ref/gvibu_ref/commands/<cmd>.py
  - Rust implementation patch
    - Add or update rust/src/commands/<cmd>.rs
  - Tests
    - Add or update shared-tests/cases/<cmd>.json
    - Add or update tests/test_<cmd>.py where appropriate
  - Dispatcher wiring
    - Update python-ref/main.py to register the new command
    - Update rust/src/main.rs to route the new command (and ensure run_args types match)
  - Documentation
    - Update docs/command-status.md to reflect statuses
  - Optional helpers
    - Add or update tooling/tmux-run-parallel.sh (tmux-based parallel tester)
    - Add/extend CI workflow parity.yml in .github/workflows
Patch structure guidance (one or more commands)
- Begin Patch: Add/Update all files for a single command before moving to the next
  - *** Begin Patch
  - *** Add File: specs/commands/<cmd>.md
  - *** Add File: python-ref/gvibu_ref/commands/<cmd>.py
  - *** Add File: rust/src/commands/<cmd>.rs
  - *** Add File: shared-tests/cases/<cmd>.json
  - *** Add File: tests/test_<cmd>.py
  - *** Update File: python-ref/gvibu_ref/main.py
  - *** Update File: rust/src/main.rs
  - *** Update File: docs/command-status.md
  - *** Update File: tooling/compare_impls.py
  - *** Optional Patch: tooling/tmux-run-parallel.sh
  - *** End Patch
- After applying patches for all commands, run parity locally:
  - Build Rust: cd rust && cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml
  - Run parity: python3 tooling/compare_impls.py
  - Run Python unit tests: pytest -q tests/test_*.py
- If parity fails:
  - Reconcile stdout/stderr/exit_code mismatches by adjusting either the implementations or the test fixtures
  - Re-run parity until all commands pass
What to run to verify (commands you can execute)
- Local parity
  - Build Rust parity: cd rust && cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml
  - Run parity: python3 tooling/compare_impls.py
- Unit tests (Python)
  - pytest -q tests/test_pwd.py tests/test_echo.py tests/test_true.py tests/test_basename.py
  - If you have additional tests you added for other commands, run them similarly
- Optional tmux-based quick test
  - Run: bash tooling/tmux-run-parallel.sh (if you have tmux installed)
  - Attaches you to a session with test panes
What to update in CI
- .github/workflows/parity.yml (new)
  - Sets up Python and Rust toolchains
  - Builds Rust parity
  - Runs parity checks: python3 tooling/compare_impls.py
  - Runs Python unit tests for the MVP commands plus new commands
  - Reports success/failure as the CI status
What I’ve done so far (summary of progress I can reuse in the loop)
- pwd: implemented in Python and Rust; tests added
- echo: implemented in Python and Rust; tests added
- true: implemented in Python and Rust; tests added
- basename: implemented in Python and Rust; parity wired; CI scaffolding added; parity passes after a few fixes
- tmux script: replaced with robust version; optional
- CI: added parity workflow
- All parity (true/echo/pwd/basename) now passes in the latest run
